answer: Bonded re-execution audits: each agent escrows a deposit before a paid task, and a random sample of finished tasks is re-run by verifiers. A wrong result slashes the deposit and burns that identity's history, so a Sybil operator cannot mint personas for free — each needs its own deposit and real work, as any task may be audited. Trust climbs a spiral staircase, one verified step at a time, and one marble of fraud can crack the climb. Honest agents pay only the audit overhead, while an attacker funding a thousand fake islands faces a thousand deposits plus the cost of work they hoped to fake.
